title: Pick the Right @spideriq/mcp-* Package
summary: Decide which @spideriq/mcp-* npm package to install for a SpiderIQ project, and fix tools that don't load. Use whenever the user asks 'which @spideriq/mcp do I install?', '@spideriq/mcp vs @spideriq/mcp-publish', 'facade mode', 'why is the agent dropping tools?', 'unknown tool', 'no SpiderIQ tools in Antigravity', or any package-selection question. Default: @spideriq/mcp-publish (~160 tools). If the host drops the tool list or reports unknown tool, run @spideriq/mcp in facade mode (SPIDERIQ_MCP_MODE=facade: ~9 tools listed, every tool reachable). Antigravity also needs SPIDERIQ_WORKSPACE pinned in the server env because it never finds spideriq.json.
